#### 4. Engagement Hub

The NICE Engagement Hub lets on-premise customers layer NICE AI and CX capabilities onto existing environments, enabling a slower, more cautious CCaaS migration.

For instance, one large UK financial services organization running Cisco used the Engagement Hub to deploy NiCE Cognigy, Agent Assist, Copilot, and analytics, achieving AI transformation without replacing its core contact center infrastructure.
